cream.$description: Cream — Page canvas, hero backgrounds, card surfaces — the warm paper-white that makes every photograph feel tactile

soft-charcoal.$description: Soft Charcoal — Body copy, secondary headings, button borders, input borders — warm near-black that sits softer than pure #000

pure-black.$description: Pure Black — Dark supporting neutral for text, icons, and strong contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

bone-white.$description: Bone White — Secondary card surface, button border tint, subtle elevated panels

stone-border.$description: Stone Border — Hairline dividers, image borders, card outlines, input borders — the structural 1px that holds the system together

ash-mist.$description: Ash Mist — Muted helper text, secondary metadata, inactive nav, sub-labels

slate-stone.$description: Slate Stone — Tertiary text, icon secondary states, disabled button text

dusk.$description: Dusk — Subtle background fills for alternating sections, muted surface layer

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Text on dark fills, inverted button text, clean card highlights

onyx-pill.$description: Onyx Pill — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

sage-whisper.$description: Sage Whisper — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

akkuratll.$description: Primary workhorse — body text, navigation, buttons, labels, UI chrome. Weight 400 for body, 500 for labels, 700 for emphasis. Light weights (200/300) appear in large display sizes for an airy editorial feel. Custom alternative: Inter, Neue Haas Grotesk, or Söhne.

editorial-new.$description: Display serif reserved for hero headlines and emotional section titles. Light weight (100/300) with negative tracking creates high-contrast elegance. Italic cuts deliver the poetic 'Made for you.' moments. Custom alternative: GT Super, Canela, or Domaine Display.
